name: Chicken Over Rice Co.
blocked: Only reachable priced source is a DoorDash white-label order.online storefront, and its 30 unique items carry a uniform 20% markup - every price divides cleanly to a round dollar at /1.2 (e.g. $20.40->$17.00, $21.60->$18.00, $4.80->$4.00, $9.60->$8.00, $2.40->$2.00), so the displayed prices are not the restaurant's real prices and the divided figures would be a constructed price, not an observed one. The restaurant's own Wix site (chickenoverrice.co) publishes no menu page or prices at all - its nav "Menu" control opens the same order.online storefront. Yelp blocked a direct fetch (776-byte response, needs a browser to check for a dated menu photo).
notes: Categories seen on the markup-tainted source: CHICKEN OVER RICE CO (bowls/pitas/salads), Chicken Bowls, Chickpea Bowls, Sides, Drinks, Build Your Own - a plausible full menu shape for a Mediterranean chicken-bowl counter, just not a usable price source.

name: Wormwood
notes: First-party Toast storefront, __OO_STATE__ blob (200 with default curl UA, no Chrome UA needed). The restaurant's own printed PDF menu (linked from wormwoodsd.com) is a French-tasting-menu-style card with ZERO per-item prices anywhere except an ounce-priced prosciutto add-on, so it could only be used to cross-check dish names/sections, not prices - Wagyu Tartare, Burrata Salad, Chocolate Tart, Creme Brulee etc. all match between the two, confirming the Toast catalog is current, not stale. Whole-dollar prices throughout; tested against 1.04/1.1/1.15/1.2 divisors with no clean fit (14-23 of 49 items each, no consistent pattern) - not a markup, just round POS pricing. Captured the standing menus: A LA CARTE (Pour Commencer/A Partager/Entrees/Desserts), Happy Hour Food, and Brunch (a fixed-price 2- or 3-course format at $39/$45 - recorded the two priced course-tiers plus the two dishes that carry a real supplement charge; the ~13 other brunch dish choices carry no per-item price under the prix fixe and were dropped per the no-price rule) plus priced Brunch Add-ons. Deliberately EXCLUDED as adjunct/uncertain-currency: the full Cocktails/Spirits/Wines/Beers/NA Beverages catalog (730 total items in the raw capture; this is a self-described absinthe bar with an extensive back-bar reference - Absinthe(42), Classic Cocktails(82), Wine BTB(50) etc - treated as a back-bar/wine-list adjunct per the exclude-adjuncts rule) and several oddly-named special/seasonal menus that read as one-off events rather than standing offerings (Gourmet Hour, Celebration Menu, SG Food Menu, La Nuit Verte, Candlelight, Bastille Day, Mother's Day Brunch, and the EVENTS PACKAGES catering tiers).

blocked: Ordering runs on Menufy (location-id 5514). The site page carries an api-key attribute (api.menufy.com, key SpeedyDesertTortoise base64-encoded) on custom HTML elements, but that key is not a working bare HTTP credential from curl: /v1/locations/5514 and /v1/locations/5514/categories resolve (IIS routes them, confirmed via a deliberate 404 on a sibling path) but return 401 with every header casing tried (api-key, apikey, x-api-key, ApiKey) and as a query param; /v1/locations/5514/menu, /menus, /menu-items, /menu-categories, /info all 404. The real menu request is built by Menufy's front-end JS with additional auth (session/CSRF) this curl-only setup can't reproduce - needs a browser to capture the actual authenticated network request. No DoorDash/UberEats/order.online listing turned up in a quick search.
notes: Restaurant's own homepage confirms cuisine (Mexican & vegan - breakfast burritos, wings, soups, tortas, tacos) but carries no prices itself; all pricing lives behind the gated Menufy API.

name: Hungry Lu's
blocked: Restaurant's own site (hungrylus.com) is a pure client-side Canva-built SPA - the initial HTML ships zero content and no menu/order link; its JS bundle references only Canva/Vimeo/embed hosts, no ordering-platform API, so this needs a browser to see what (if anything) renders. Only one tier-5 priced source was reachable: allmenus.com (Grubhub-owned, dated 2023), 24 items across Salads/8" Personal Pizza/Classic Sub/Signature Sub, including one clearly-wrong outlier ("OB Special" pizza listed at $50.00 against sibling pizzas at $5-6.45). Per the two-independent-sources rule for tier 5: menuwithpricesonline.com mirrors the identical allmenus text and the identical $50 typo (a copy, not independent corroboration); hungry-lus.wheree.com is Cloudflare-gated (needs a browser); restaurantji.com lists dish names with no prices at all; hungry-lus.edan.io is a barred farm domain, not checked.
notes: Address (4920 Voltaire Street) matches the work list. Confirmed identity: Italian deli/bakery (subs, personal pizzas, salads, cannoli) per Yelp/Restaurantji reviews, consistent with the allmenus item list.
